Added five tests on the real tally sample in a new survey-unit test file, proved each fails pre-fix, restored no-foreign-edits guarantee, and ran the full check battery: everything passes except six failures owned by the concurrent gates and rules units.

How I checked PL6-7 against the code:
- I diffed the current story_ready.py against a pre-fix copy left in the scratchpad (scratchpad/next/tests/unit/story_ready.py). The only changes are `import tomllib` and the body of _install_product, so product=None is untouched.
- A directory product now skips .factory and .git. When the product has .factory/factory.toml, only its [paths] table is applied, every key of it. Without one, paths.source gets <dir>/** for each copied directory only, never a file. The commit on develop before admission is kept.
- I built a project from the real sample and loaded the result. paths is tests=[tests/**], harness=[], ci=[], repo_config=[.gitignore], manifests=[], docs=[README.md], source=[tally/**, tools/**]. delivery.mode is local, state.push is false, commands.test is "python -m pytest -q". vsdd.config.load accepts it.
- `vsdd validate` refuses with condition 'ready', but it refuses the same way for product=None and for a bare init, so the refusal is not caused by the fix.
- Callable product: the old code set source=[src/**]. The new code leaves init's value, which is also [src/**], so the result is the same. `tops = ["src"]` in that branch is now dead code (a nit, not filed).

Tests checked in a scratch copy of next/ (no .venv) with the repo's venv python:
- On the pre-fix code, all 5 new tests fail. On the fixed code, all 5 pass.
- Not applying the sample's [paths]: test 2 fails.
- Copying .factory: tests 1, 3 and 5 fail.
- Putting top-level files into source: test 4 fails.
- Not committing the product, or committing it on a side branch: test 3 fails.
- Applying the sample's [state] (push=true) as well: all 5 still pass.
- Applying only the tests and source keys of [paths]: all 5 still pass.
- `own != sample` (the text comparison in test 1) can never fail, because set_keys always rewrites factory.toml after the copy.
These last three gaps are filed as minor step3-survey-fix-3-C1-1.

- make_project(tmp_path, product=<directory>, story=...) copies top-level files and directories (.gitignore included) and commits them as 'sample product' on develop before the survey admits the story.
- It returns the project root.
- It uses story_ready.SESSION and story_ready.run_vsdd.
- Afterwards it overrides [commands] (test=<sys.executable> tools/junit_runner.py, test_report=junit:build/junit.xml) and [paths] itself.
It strips .factory itself before calling, so it takes the no-factory.toml branch. That leaves paths.source = tally/**, tests/**, tools/** briefly, until its own set_keys replaces it. It could now pass tests/e2e/sample-project directly.

fix.summary: Fixed the single finding step3-survey-fix-3-C1-1 (minor, test-strength) in next/tests/unit/test_story_ready.py. The product-install code in next/tests/unit/story_ready.py was already correct; the gap was that the tests proved less than they looked. Changes, all confined to the test file: (1) removed the never-failing `assert own != sample` text comparison and replaced it with assertions on the loaded Config; (2) test_product_directory_keeps_the_project_configuration now asserts config.get("state", "push") is False and delivery.mode is "local", with the sample's own push=True / mode="pr" asserted beside them so the discrimination is provably real; (3) test_product_directory_sets_paths_from_the_sample now asserts the whole [paths] table equals the sample's, read with tomllib from next/tests/e2e/sample-project/.factory/factory.toml (all seven keys: tests, harness, ci, repo_config, manifests, docs, source), not just tests and source. Proved by mutation in a scratch copy of the tree: applying the sample's [state] fails the configuration test on the push check; applying only tests/source fails the paths test on table equality; the pre-fix wholesale copy of the sample's .factory fails three tests; the unmutated code passes all five. Spec updates were not needed (test-only change, no design fact moved). The gates builder's next/tests/unit/gate_project.py was read before working: it relies on story_ready.make_project(tmp_path, product=<staged dir without .factory>, story=...) plus story_ready.SESSION and story_ready.run_vsdd — all untouched, since no product file changed.
